acceptance: validate_corpus.py counts non-power phase cohorts separately, with a test proving a one-engine throughput cohort fails
The TPC-H SF1 throughput cohort has three genuine engine identities (DuckDB, Spark, Doris) run with matching settings and all rankable
A replacement corpus PR from current develop passes the depth gate and merges; #2382 is closed with a link to it
context: 2026-10-07 closer finding (verified on origin/develop ea93839df): the throughput cohort can never gain a rankable bundle under the current rules. validate_corpus.py::_primary_metric_reason requires summary.tpc_metrics.power_at_size for tpch, but throughput-only bundles never run the power phase (power_test NOT_RUN, e.g. tpch_sf1_duckdb_sql_20260925_224454_6155be3c.json) so they always hit missing_primary_metric; conversely bundle_phase() classifies any run with an executed power phase into the power cohort, so full official runs never land in tpch SF1.0#throughput#3streams. Current validator output: that cohort holds 4 bundles (2026-09-25, all 0-based stream ids {0,1,2}) with 0 rankable identities. Closing this item as written needs an owner decision: either rank throughput-phase cohorts on throughput_at_size, or redefine the acceptance (e.g. full power+throughput runs per engine). Do not re-run engines until that decision lands; fresh runs alone cannot satisfy the gate.
description:
PR #2382 adds four DuckDB TPC-H SF1 throughput bundles. The inventory puts them in their own `tpch@sf1.0#throughput` cohort, which has one engine identity. But `results-data/validate_corpus.py` keys cohorts by benchmark and scale only, so its depth gate passes that cohort by counting power-phase engines. SEED_CORPUS_SPEC.md requires three identities per cohort.

Prepared, unpublished: a phase-aware validate_corpus.py change and test (uncommitted in worktree ~/Developer/BenchBox.wt-throughput-corpus), and a passing Spark 4.2.0 throughput bundle as the second identity (~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/tpch_sf1_spark_sql_20261003_184247_2a8045c8.json, official, 3 streams, 66/66 queries, seed 20260709, notuning).

Third identity (owner decision 2026-10-04): Apache Doris via local Docker, run after the TPC-H throughput dialect fix merges, from merged develop, with settings matching the cohort (TPC-H SF1, --official, --streams 3, --seed 20260709, --tuning notuning). SQLite was rejected as too slow. DataFusion, ClickHouse Local and Polars declare throughput unsupported. #2382 is to be closed and replaced by a fresh PR from current develop.
